mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( reservation_code, reservation_slot_id, visit_type_id, visit_type_label, guest_count, staff_memo, summary_headline, questionnaire_result_code, slot_label, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationCode}, #{reservationSlotId}, #{visitTypeId}, #{visitTypeLabel}, #{guestCount}, #{staffMemo}, #{summaryHeadline}, #{questionnaireResultCode}, #{slotLabel}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT id, reservation_code, reservation_slot_id, visit_type_id, visit_type_label, guest_count, staff_memo, summary_headline, questionnaire_result_code, slot_label, created_at, updated_at FROM reservations WHERE reservation_code = #{reservationCode}

SELECT r.reservation_code, r.reservation_slot_id, r.visit_type_label, r.guest_count, r.staff_memo, r.summary_headline, r.questionnaire_result_code, r.slot_label, r.created_at, r.updated_at, rs.slot_date, rs.slot_time, rs.status AS slot_status, rs.instructor_name, qr.route_code, qr.step1_answers_json, qr.step2_answers_json, qr.graph_axes_json FROM reservations r INNER JOIN reservation_slots rs ON rs.id = r.reservation_slot_id LEFT JOIN questionnaire_results qr ON qr.result_code = r.questionnaire_result_code ORDER BY rs.slot_date ASC, rs.slot_time ASC, r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.reservation_code, r.reservation_slot_id, r.visit_type_label, r.guest_count, r.staff_memo, r.summary_headline, r.questionnaire_result_code, r.slot_label, r.created_at, r.updated_at, rs.slot_date, rs.slot_time, rs.status AS slot_status, rs.instructor_name, qr.route_code, qr.step1_answers_json, qr.step2_answers_json, qr.graph_axes_json FROM reservations r INNER JOIN reservation_slots rs ON rs.id = r.reservation_slot_id LEFT JOIN questionnaire_results qr ON qr.result_code = r.questionnaire_result_code WHERE r.reservation_code = #{reservationCode}
